baseline_reference.description: Task 18 cutover: the same CEIS source document converted through the pre-Phase-4.5 combined docx-to-content plugin's full analyze/confirm/convert/render pipeline, validated PASS at both the canonical and rendered stages. Referenced by path+hash per Wave 6 Step 2's evidence-safety classification -- not duplicated (248MB tracked evidence).

process_isolation_note: canonical-knowledge and knowledge-publication both duplicate several identically-named bare modules (canonical_schema, atomic_output, hashing, dispositions, publication_map, canonical_package -- see wave-4/wave-5 decision docs). Co-installing both into ONE long-lived Python interpreter and importing both by bare name in that same process causes a real namespace collision (only one plugin's copy of each shared bare name survives on sys.path). The golden-master run above therefore executes canonical_knowledge.build_canonical_package and knowledge_publication.render in two SEPARATE Python processes (matching how these plugins are actually meant to be invoked -- each as its own independently-installed skill/CLI, not a shared long-lived multi-plugin interpreter). This is not a bug in the pipeline; it is the expected boundary of the flat-bare-module, zero-shared-distribution architecture, and is the same reason combined_install_check.py runs each plugin's own test suite in an isolated subprocess rather than one shared pytest session.
